subject: POC: request for additional weeks and pilot credit structure
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@clearpath.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short pilot extension and credits

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the onboarding last week — the initial run of the model looked very promising. Our team hit a couple of evaluation blockers (integrating streaming outputs into our UI and an internal privacy review) that pushed our signal-gathering back by about 10 business days.

Would Redwood consider a 2-3 week extension on the time-boxed pilot (currently ends 12/03) and a small pilot credit we can apply to usage while we complete those items? We want to avoid spinning up a full purchase decision until we have the end-to-end integration validated.

If it helps, I can loop in contracts (cc'd) to get a quick amendment signed.

Appreciate any flexibility — we like what we've seen so far.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Head of ML, ClearPath Health
olivia@clearpath.ai

Subject: Re: Request: short pilot extension and credits

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and glad the model is progressing.

We can absolutely accommodate an extension; I need to confirm the credit/discount structure with my manager. My quick proposal to start the discussion:
- 2 week extension to the pilot end date (no additional platform fees)
- $2,500 pilot credit applied to usage billed during the extension window

If that looks reasonable to you, I'll loop in Marissa for approval and send an amendment + SOW for signature. I've attached a draft SOW (ClearPath-SOW-v1.pdf) with the extended dates so contracts can expedite.

Are you aiming for a hard stop at the end of the extension or would you prefer a flexible window (we can do a 3-week flexible option but would need a slightly higher credit)?

Thanks — I'll be on standby.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@clearpath.ai>

Cc: Nathan Li <nathan.li@clearpath.ai>, contracts@clearpath.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short pilot extension and credits

Thanks, Priyom.

We're leaning toward a 3-week flexible extension to give our PMs breathing room; if possible we'd prefer a single credit line rather than tiered discounts. Can you confirm what a 3-week option would look like (credit amount) and whether Redwood can commit to the same rate card during the extension? Pricing stability is important for our procurement review.

If you can send the amendment + an itemized term sheet, I'll forward to contracts for quick review.

Best,
Olivia

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ClearPath — request for 3-week extension and credit (need approval)

Marissa / Monica — forwarding ClearPath's ask below. Short summary: they want a 3-week flexible extension and a single pilot credit (they prefer one-line credit vs percent discount). I'm proposing $3,750 credit for 3 weeks (roughly $1,250/week) and to guarantee current rate card during the extension.

Rationale: keeps the pilot moving, small revenue impact but increases chance of conversion; ClearPath is a strategic mid-market prospect in health vertical.

Can you confirm if we can approve $3,750 as a standard concession from the sales desk, or if we should escalate to finance for an exception? If approved, I'll send an amendment + updated term sheet.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearPath — request for 3-week extension and credit (need approval)

Priyom — approved. You have leeway to offer up to a $4,000 pilot credit for this type of engagement; $3,750 is fine. Confirm the following in your amendment:
- 3-week extension window (12/04 — 12/24 inclusive)
- $3,750 one-time credit to be applied to usage during the extension window
- Rate card guarantee: current public pricing for any overage after credit is applied
- No changes to data retention or security commitments in the SOW

Also loop Monica for post-signature onboarding (she's copied) so we can accelerate ROI tracking. No need to escalate to finance for this amount.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Olivia — good news, we approved the 3-week extension and the $3,750 pilot credit. Key points:
- Extension window: 2026-12-04 through 2026-12-24 (inclusive)
- One-time $3,750 credit applied to usage during that window
- Rate card locked for the extension period (public pricing after credit)

I've attached an updated term sheet (pilot-credit-term-sheet.xlsx) and re-attached the SOW with new dates. Contracts is copied and will send a short amendment for signature. If you confirm the amendment, we'll fire off a DocuSign link for an electronic signature.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you accept the terms in this email.
2) Contracts will send the amendment (DocuSign) — sign and return.
3) Monica will schedule a 30-minute onboarding sync for Dec 6 to review instrumentation and the streaming integration checklist.

Thanks — appreciate the quick cadence.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
